title: Sliding uPVC Doors
whatIsIt: A multi-track door system where large glass panels slide horizontally, built for maximum daylight and airflow across wide openings.
whyChooseIt: Handles expansive, wall-sized openings that a hinged door can't — ideal when you want a room to open straight onto a balcony or garden.

benefits.title: Maximum natural light
benefits.description: Large glass panels flood interiors with daylight.

benefits.title: Built for big openings
benefits.description: Supports floor-to-ceiling installations with wind-load resistance for larger sizes.

series.description: Ideal for large openings requiring maximum natural light and airflow, with flexible track-and-shutter configurations and wind-load resistance for bigger sizes.
